title: The Birthday Paradox
tagline: Put 23 people in a room and it's a coin flip that two share a birthday. Really.
description: With only 23 people in a room, the odds that two share a birthday pass 50%. Fill a room, count the pairs, run the numbers a thousand times, and see why the same math keeps hackers up at night.
coverAlt: A cartoon birthday cake with candles beside two identical calendar pages
